title: WildArch Fates
description: WildArch Fates is a vanilla-friendly RPG plugin that makes your experience even better! With 4 distinct playable classes: Mage, Samurai, Alchemist, and risk-taking Gambler. Master unique abilities, 10 brand-new custom potions, and 3 new, custom totems!
body:
⚔️ WildArch Fates
Transform your Minecraft server into a high-stakes, class-based RPG! WildArch Fates is a feature-rich SMP plugin that introduces unique playstyles, custom abilities, and game-changing items. Whether you prefer the shadows, the arcane, the brewing stand, or the thrill of the gamble, your fate is in your hands.


✨ Features
4 Distinct Playable Classes with completely custom, cooldown-based ability kits.
3 Game-Changing Custom Totems that completely overhaul the vanilla death-evasion mechanics.
10 New Custom Potions to expand your arsenal and turn the tide of battle.

Lightweight & Vanilla-Friendly: No resource packs or mods required. Everything runs natively using vanilla items!


🛡️ Choose Your Fate (Classes)

🧙‍♂️ The Mage - 
Master the arcane arts and control the battlefield from afar.

Fireball Volley: Launch a barrage of explosive fireballs.

Arcane Pulse: Unleash a shockwave that damages and knocks back nearby threats.

Meteor Mark: Mark a target to be struck by a delayed, devastating explosion.

Mana Shield: Summon a magical barrier that absorbs incoming damage until it shatters.


🗡️ The Samurai - 
Strike from the shadows with lethal precision and unmatched mobility.

Shadow Dash: Dash forward, slicing through any enemies in your path.

Vanish: Slip into the shadows with true invisibility.

Backstab: Your next strike from behind an enemy deals double damage.

Smoke Bomb: Drop a blinding cloud of smoke to disorient your foes.


🧪 The Alchemist - 
Transmutes matter and manipulate elements to control the flow of combat.

Quick-Brew: Instantly launch primed Healing or Slowness splash potions.

Potion Vault: Access a virtual, portable chest to store your most valuable brews.

Toxic Burst: Release a devastating AoE cloud of Poison and Slowness.

Transmute: Magically convert standard items in your hand into valuable brewing ingredients.


🎲 The Gambler - 
High risk, high reward. Let the dice decide your destiny.

Dice Roll: Roll for random buffs (Huge Strength, Big Heals) or devastating debuffs (Weakness, Self-Damage).

All In!: Deal double damage for 5 seconds, followed by heavy exhaustion and hunger.

Jackpot: Risk it all for a 5% chance at the Ultimate Jackpot (Max Health, Speed, Resistance, Regen). Fail, and the house takes your health.

Passive: Casino Totem ALWAYS gives positive effects.


🗿 Custom Totems of Undying
Vanilla totems are boring. We've introduced three new artifacts with incredible on-pop effects:

⏳ Chronos Totem: ZA WARUDO! Popping this totem stops time, freezing all nearby players and mobs in their tracks.

👻 Ghostly Totem: Upon death, instantly enter a temporary "Ghost Phase" (Spectator Mode) to safely phase through walls and escape your attackers.

🎰 Casino Totem: A highly volatile artifact. If a Gambler uses it, they receive massive regeneration. If any other class tries to use it... the house always wins, inflicting severe Wither.


📜 Commands & Usage
/ability <class> <1-4> - Cast your active abilities.
/class <set/reset> [class] <nick>
/giveitem <item>

(Note: We recommend binding these commands to items or using a macro mod for the ultimate combat experience!)
